thesis: Endpoint strength and an above-class approval base rate outweigh the financing and CMC risks; the catalyst is more likely positive than not, but the CRL analogs keep it short of a slam dunk.
bull_strongest_point: Phase 3 primary endpoint met at p<0.001 with an approval base rate above the oncology class mean (tool:base_rate#a1b2c3).
bear_strongest_point: Two analogs in this review division took a manufacturing CRL and cash runway ends one quarter post-PDUFA — the strongest surviving bear point.
unresolved_dissent: CMC inspection status not confirmable before the decision date
kill_criteria: A complete response letter is issued
An FDA advisory committee votes against approval before the PDUFA date
